公司的人都知道总裁发火了，就在时笙他们离开后。

没人知道他们在里面谈了什么，只知道公司和时笙解除了合同，就连唐隐也辞职了。

夏满开车，时笙坐在副驾驶，唐隐坐在后面。

到现在他都有点懵圈，他进去后一句话都没说，就听自家艺人和夏满一人一句，迅速的将席墨给解决了。

不但合同解除了，就连他也被‘挖’走了？

“公司地址我已经选好了，资金已经到位。”时笙可没心情理会唐隐的心情，低着头迅速的在笔记本上打着字，“接下来最重要的就是艺人了。”

“嗯，艺人方面我们还得请专业的人士。”夏满心底是有些喟叹的。

就在一个月前，她把母亲留给她的所有资产交到了她手上，她母亲留给她的资金不算少，加上不动产和一些珠宝，足足有五千万。

五千万，不是五百万。

当时她都不明白自己为什么相信她，明明她说得那么浮夸，那么的不走心。

可是她的表情太过于真诚了……真诚得让人不由自主的相信。

可是一个月后，她看着自己翻了倍的资产，除了震惊还是震惊。

这赚钱的速度……简直是要上天啊！

“资金我留了一部分，毕竟以后用钱的地方还多，我得多赚点，前期资金，五千万已经够了。”

夏满没有意见，虽然启动资金是她的，可是这些资金在她手中想要翻倍根本是不可能的。

“等等……”听了半天的唐隐，总算反应过来了，“你们要开公司？”

“对啊，公司都已经注册好了。”时笙扭头看着唐隐，“艺人方面还是需要你负责，我想要……那种长得美美哒，萌萌哒的，只要往台上一站，什么都不用做，也能让人看一两个小时的那种。”

夏满：“……”这哪儿是艺人，这是国宝吧？

唐隐：“……”他家艺人在这一个月到底做了什么？现在的艺人套路都这么深了？

之前在电梯里她说的那段话，是在这里等着他的吧？

绝逼是！

总感觉上了贼船是什么肿么回事？

因为唐隐的加入，一些被两个妹纸忽略的问题，被唐隐提了出来，避免了一些歪路。

唐隐受的教育不比那些富二代差，许多问题他都看得比较透彻。

Everyone in the company knew that the president was angry just after Shi Sheng and the others left.

No one knew what they discussed inside. They only knew that the company and Shi Sheng terminated the contract, and even Tang Yin resigned.

Xia Man drove, Shi Sheng sat in the passenger seat, and Tang Yin sat in the back.

He was still a little confused until now. He didn't say a word after entering. He just listened to his own artist and Xia Man and quickly dealt with Xi Mo.

Not only was the contract terminated, but he was also 'poached' away?

"I have chosen the company address and the funds have been received." Shi Sheng was not in the mood to pay attention to Tang Yin's mood. He lowered his head and typed quickly on his notebook, "The most important thing next is the artist."

"Well, we have to hire professionals as artists." Xia Man sighed a little in his heart.

Just a month ago, she handed over all the assets her mother left to her. The funds her mother left her were not small, plus real estate and some jewelry, it amounted to 50 million.

Fifty million, not five million.

At that time, she didn't even understand why she believed her. It was obvious that what she said was so exaggerated and so sincere.

But her expression was too sincere... so sincere that people couldn't help but believe it.

But a month later, when she saw her assets doubled, she was shocked.

The speed at which you make money... is simply astonishing!

"I have reserved part of the funds. After all, there will be more places to use money in the future. I have to earn more. Fifty million is enough for the initial capital."

Xia Man had no objection. Although the start-up capital was hers, it was impossible for her to double the capital.

"Wait a minute..." After listening for a long time, Tang Yin finally came to his senses, "You want to open a company?"

"Yes, the company has been registered." Shi Sheng turned to look at Tang Yin, "You still need to be responsible for the artist. I want... the kind of person who is beautiful and cute. You only need to stand on the stage and do nothing, and can be watched for an hour or two."

Xia Man: "..." This is not an artist. Is this a national treasure?

Tang Yin: "..." What exactly did his artist do this month?Are today’s artists so sophisticated?

What she said in the elevator before was waiting for him here, right?

Absolutely yes!

Why do you always feel like you're on a pirate ship?

Because of Tang Yin's participation, some issues that had been ignored by the two girls were brought up by Tang Yin, thus avoiding some detours.

Tang Yin's education was no worse than that of the rich second generation, and he saw many issues more thoroughly.
